title.zh: 取得的目的修订进入在途任务
title.en: Acquired goal revision enters a pending task

claim.zh: 对每条带计数工作的部分律，待完成任务恰在剩余工作加一次中完成，更短的运行都不交付。在既有版本化交付不变量下，改写队首包的剩余编码保持其已捕获路线、进度与其余工作，所以修订后的队首对新请求仍是这样的任务，剩余工作相同、完成次数相同。把取得的、有比较根据的目的修订接到这一改写，端点行动就执行新做法，保留历史损失并消耗实际工作支持；参数化组合覆盖任何有效队首。
claim.en: For every partial law with counted work, a pending task finishes in exactly its remaining work plus one tick, and no shorter run delivers it. Under the existing versioned-delivery invariant, rewriting the head packet's remaining encoding preserves its captured route, progress and other work, so the revised head is again such a task for the new request, with the same remaining work and the same number of ticks. Connecting acquired, comparatively warranted goal revision to this rewrite makes endpoint action enact the new practice, retaining historical loss and consuming actual work support; the parameterized composition covers any valid head.

hypotheses.zh: 二元可逆转译、有效队列与受保护的同步头请求改写，执行前无未建模的不可逆效果；连续 tick 提供完成。
hypotheses.en: Binary reversible translation, a valid queue and protected synchronous head rewrite; no unmodeled irreversible effects before endpoint enactment. Consecutive ticks provide completion.

hypotheses.zh: 复用已取得的两实践证据、目的改变及选择改革；G0/J、实际对应、权限与响应明示。新分支消耗一单位改写工作；传递维护成本没有建模。
hypotheses.en: Reuse acquired two-practice evidence, changed purpose and selector reform; G0/J, correspondence, authority and responsiveness are explicit. The branch consumes one rewrite work unit; route-maintenance cost is not modeled.

correspondence.zh: 学习、指令与实际作用是同一活动中的关系分化；不是博弈双方。实际目标只编码为所声明的两种实践，相关处境须在应用时匹配。
correspondence.en: Learning, instruction and effect are differentiated relations in one activity, not opposing players. The goal encoding covers only the two declared practices, with actual relevant conditions required to match.

detail.zh: revised_head_completes 直接调用既有 valid_head_completes，传入经 retarget_head_invariant 建立的新不变量。
detail.en: revised_head_completes directly calls valid_head_completes with the new invariant established by retarget_head_invariant.

output.zh: 有效队列中的头请求沿保留路线完成并保留其余任务。
output.en: A valid head completes along its retained route while preserving other work.

input.zh: 改写后的实际载荷需要被完成定理消费；retargeted_act_uses_delivered_revision 将输出再送入实际行动。
input.en: The rewritten payload must satisfy the completion theorem; retargeted_act_uses_delivered_revision then supplies its output to enactment.

conditions.zh: 相同银行、剩余路径和调度；只改变头项编码与请求值。
conditions.en: Same banks, remaining path and schedule; only the head encoding and request change.

detail.zh: warranted_revision_and_pending_delivery 直接消费旧比较；continuation 消费 completed 的实际状态及储备。
detail.en: warranted_revision_and_pending_delivery consumes the inherited comparison; continuation consumes the actual completed state and account.

output.zh: 已取得、校准、修订且改革后的状态及其有根据比较。
output.en: Acquired, calibrated, revised and reformed state with its warranted comparison.

input.zh: paidRetarget 从该状态读目的并消耗一工作单位；实际送达值决定端点实践。
input.en: paidRetarget reads that state’s goal and consumes one work unit; the delivered value determines endpoint practice.

conditions.zh: 保留同一 harmful 条件、实践解释、G0/J、先前损失和有限资源，不推断任意共享动机。
conditions.en: Retains the same harmful conditions, practice interpretation, G0/J, earlier losses and finite resources, without inferring arbitrary shared motivation.

detail.zh: 只改标签或直接写未编码值会失败；旧任务可被忠实执行而增加损失。取得根据后处境改变，也可使修订后的实践增加维护损失；不证明开放共同目的形成或无限变化中的纠正。
detail.en: Relabeling or writing an unencoded value can fail; the old task can be faithfully executed and add loss. Changed conditions after acquisition can also make the revised practice harm maintenance. No open joint-purpose formation or correction through unrestricted change.

limitations.zh: 只改标签或直接写未编码值会失败；旧任务可被忠实执行而增加损失。取得根据后处境改变，也可使修订后的实践增加维护损失；不证明开放共同目的形成或无限变化中的纠正。
limitations.en: Relabeling or writing an unencoded value can fail; the old task can be faithfully executed and add loss. Changed conditions after acquisition can also make the revised practice harm maintenance. No open joint-purpose formation or correction through unrestricted change.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.30.0-rc2 实际重建导入闭包并审计；明确区分原成果和新增组合。元数据检查不替代数学证明。一般律仅经scratch实编。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.30.0-rc2 actually rebuilt the repository import closure and audited declarations; inherited claims and the new composition remain distinct. Metadata checks do not replace proofs. General laws: scratch builds only.

next_delta.zh: 直接复用在途改写；pending-task-context-applicability 已接通有成本的作用前复查。继续说明相关性取得和旧做法不适用时真实需求的有支持接续。
next_delta.en: Reuse pending rewriting directly; pending-task-context-applicability now connects paid pre-effect review. Continue acquisition of relevance and supported continuation of actual needs when the old method is inapplicable.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：新增一项组合成果；17项定理声明／27项审计与188项继承定理／327项继承审计分别列出。作者反审已记录，未声称独立验收。
history.en: 2026-10-09: one new composition result; 17 theorem declarations/27 audits are separated from 188 inherited theorems/327 inherited audits. Author counterreview is recorded; no independent acceptance is claimed.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：核读并接入后续端点复查，文稿增加行动保护与比较理由的区分；本记录的在途改写定理及原回执不变。
history.en: 2026-10-09: reread and integrated the endpoint-review continuation and its action-protection/comparative-warrant distinction; this record’s pending-rewrite theorem and original receipt are unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-14：按旧记录一般律审计，主张改为一般律先行。新核心模块 Becoming.Countdown：计数的工作恰在剩余工作加一次中完成；改写后的队首经外围 VersionedTaskInstances 仍是 Countdown.Advances 的实例，revised_head_completes 是实例。有比较根据的修订条件仍是该协议的事实。scratch_build 实编，核心公理报告为空，外围只用标准公理；回执由落地运行绑定。原定理、回执与反例不变。
history.en: 2026-10-14: under the general-law audit of older records, the claim now states the law first. New core module Becoming.Countdown: counted work finishes in exactly its remaining work plus one tick; through the periphery VersionedTaskInstances the rewritten head stays an instance of Countdown.Advances, and revised_head_completes is an instance. The warranted-revision conditions remain facts of the protocol. Built with scratch_build: core axiom reports empty, the periphery with standard axioms only; the landing run binds the receipts. The original theorems, receipts and counterexamples are unchanged.
